hints.title: Try every candidate root
hints.body: The embedded subtree must start at some node of the larger tree. Visit each node and consider it as a candidate.

hints.title: Reuse an equality check
hints.body: Write a helper that decides whether two trees are identical. Run it for every candidate node in the larger tree.

hints.title: Cover the empty cases
hints.body: An empty `subRoot` always matches. An empty `root` cannot contain a non-empty `subRoot`.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
function identical(a, b):
    if a is null and b is null: return true
    if a is null or b is null: return false
    return a.value == b.value
        and identical(a.left, b.left)
        and identical(a.right, b.right)

function contains(root, sub):
    if sub is null: return true
    if root is null: return false
    if identical(root, sub): return true
    return contains(root.left, sub) or contains(root.right, sub)
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution.
